criteria.evidence: Opens with "only if you need more than what you have" and explains logs/tests already cover failures and latency in dev; a framework earns place for production, many runs, multi-step traces. Ends by advising holding off for a prototype.

"Keep your tests as they are", "Add a trace ID to your existing log lines", and "Structured JSON logs plus your tests are likely enough" show building on existing logging/tests; also suggests using existing Datadog/New Relic rather than adding another tool.
No discussion of maintenance burden, dependency footprint, or operational cost of self-hosting backends. Only a vague mention of "heavy framework" and "self-host" options without costs.
